purpose: Expected predicates for the Deep Agents loop under the controlled planning fixture, committed before the recorded observation run. Counterdex computes every scientific outcome; these predicates only say which branch each reviewed input should reach.
lane_note: The controlled planning model is a deterministic test fixture run through the real create_deep_agent graph, worker, ports and Counterdex. It is not live Gemini reasoning.
freeze_note: C1-C3 reuse inputs whose outcomes were observed earlier (C narrow-demo qualification DEMO-04/05 on main cdb9d69 and this branch's provider-free measurement). C4 is new: its predicate was written before its first run. If an input does not reach its predicted branch, the observation reports the actual result rather than changing this file.
